title: Sign in with a JoomlArt account, land on a template from joomlart.com, download its quickstart
steps: S1: run apps/tracy-web/test/identity-joomlart.test.mjs and joomlart-sso.test.mjs — the test's own HMAC signer plays aMember.
S2: run apps/tracy-web/test/template-intent.test.mjs — /new?template=<id> signed out, signed in, unoffered, catalogue down, and the root with a template waiting.
S3: run apps/tracy-web/test/quickstart-download.test.mjs — the streaming door with a fake GitHub.
S4: the three migrations exist and the API reference snapshot names the three doors.
S5: run apps/tracy-web/test/public-signin.test.mjs. Legacy BETA_GATE=on/off with no aMember key must both send a code and preserve the selected JA Kinetic template after verification.

S6: run discord-doors.test.mjs and security-headers.test.mjs. Legacy beta config must permit non-members to verify their Discord address and the login CSP must omit the now-unused whitelist redirect origin.
expect: S1: exit 0, 0 failures; the signed-answer, replay, unverified-email, safePath-next, paid-entitlement and template-waiting cases pass.
S2: exit 0, 0 failures, 0 skipped; the five named cases pass.
S3: exit 0, 0 failures (the Postgres case may be skipped without TEST_DATABASE_URL).

S5: exit 0, 0 failures, 0 skipped; invalid codes mint no session, valid codes redirect to the requested template and existing sessions continue without another login. S1 also admits free, expired and absent memberships.
S6: both suites exit 0 with no skipped tests; the non-member receives one code without a membership request, verifies it, and form-action allows only self and the configured identity providers.
fence: A forged, replayed or foreign-nonce aMember answer never mints a session; a template the gallery does not show cannot be reached or downloaded; the GitHub token never leaves tracy-web.
